result.changelog: Primer: 'Navy' changed to 'Marines'; Ridley now 'leading their military'; added the baby Metroid / Metroid DNA clause and the Adam / ADAM clause; Samus's Federation service phrased neutrally; dropped the 'the galaxy' key. Timeline: the Norion Leviathan was destroyed, not an impact; Sylux is restrained while Samus escapes Viewros; Other M gap now unstated; Ridley clone marked accidental; 'exposes' changed to 'discovers'; Federation Force corrected (shield dropped for the fleet; Sylux hatches a captured egg); 20X6 attributed to Nintendo's published timeline; added Anthony Higgs and the helmet; spellings G.F.S. Tyr, Mothership, B.S.L.; trimmed to 550 words. Dating: removed the self-contradictory 'months at most' line (dates imply about 4 years from Zebes to Viewros); 20X6 tied to Sylux's egg theft (Nintendo Today app via NWR); Bottle Ship gap reworded as unknown; age 14 tied to a manga scene; meta framing removed; generic keys replaced. Canon: unsourced Other M 'Lady'/Brug Mass script examples cut; manga dating reconciled (online preview 2002, Magazine Z from 2003); Zero Mission prologue claim dropped; Prime 4 placement split between Nintendo (Other M to Fusion) and Retro's Famitsu 'another dimension' remark; the retellings' additions added; keys 'manga' and 'comics' replaced. Abilities: Orpheon cause rewritten (Parasite Queen, reactor self-destruct, elevator-shaft explosion); strangling removed; Legendary Power Suit named; Phazon crisis lost nothing; 'physical amnesia' kept after The Sixth Axis confirmed it is Nintendo's term; 'powerless' key dropped; second-person keys added. Mission structure: Ceres moved from endings to the opening; 'facts, not feelings' replaced (Other M narration is emotional); unverified claims about the Federation naming the Metroid and Samus as 'the last of them' dropped; 'Aran's guns' and the 'Any objections, Lady?' / thumbs-down exchange added; 'countdown' key replaced. All entries rechecked for forbidden words and keys.
result.unresolved: Federation Force placement: Wikipedia puts it after Corruption (used), Metroid Wiki says between Metroid II and Super Metroid. ADAM's 'unexplained physical changes' wording comes only from a Wikitroid search snippet, though the term 'physical amnesia' is confirmed. The 20X9 date for Prime 4 relies on Metroid Wiki and NWR, not a primary transcript. The canon entry names more than two game titles because the media list is its subject (an accepted exception). The 'Baby's Cry' signal name and Dread's 'exploding planet' were kept from the draft without a new check. Whether Samus served in the Federation Police (manga) or Army (Other M) is unresolved, so the primer stays neutral.
